title: A full address containing TX returns no matches
impact: A common copy/paste path incorrectly tells a homeowner that a known property is unavailable.
steps: Search 1104 Paw Print, Leander, TX 78641. Repeat with 1104 Paw Print Leander TX. Compare with 1104 Paw Print Leander 78641.
actual: Both TX variants fail. Street-only, trailing comma, city-only, ZIP-only and city+ZIP without TX all return ID 736302. Complete-address suggestions also fail.
fix: Normalize an optional state token in its address context and use the same parser for suggestions and submitted search. Do not blindly delete TX wherever it occurs in a street name.
accept: All listed variants return 736302; tests include Texas spelled out, out-of-county addresses and legitimate street-name tokens. No expansion into incorrect matches.

title: Data & methodology does not lead to methodology
impact: A credibility link promises evidence the destination does not provide.
steps: Click Data & methodology in the footer.
actual: The #evidence target contains Independent by design. Built for homeowners. and introductory copy.
fix: Link to a real sources/methodology page, or rename the current link About our data only after adding suitable source context.
accept: Destination gives source releases/dates, calculation definitions and limitations, or direct links to them.

title: Search-result headers are vertically misaligned
impact: The results table looks unfinished despite correctly aligned currency values.
steps: Submit a matching search at 1363 × 936 and compare Property with Market value.
actual: Text bounding tops: Property 465.953 px; Market value 478.953 px. Same 15 px text height; 13 px offset.
fix: Align both header cells to a shared baseline or center; remove mismatched button/tooltip-wrapper padding without shrinking its hit area.
accept: Text baselines align within 1 px at desktop sizes; narrow layouts and expanded tooltip remain readable.

title: Footer external-link arrow wraps onto an orphan line
impact: The arrow appears detached from its link and disrupts footer rhythm.
steps: Scroll to the footer at the baseline viewport.
actual: Official Appraisal District search wraps the external arrow onto a line by itself.
fix: Use a nonbreaking final word/icon group or an inline-flex label/icon treatment; allow the label itself to wrap.
accept: No orphan arrow at 320–1440 px widths or at enlarged text settings.

title: Whitespace-only search silently returns to home
impact: The required-field rule is inconsistent and gives no explanation.
actual: Navigates to /?q= and displays the home page; fully empty input instead gets required-field validation.
fix: Trim before validation and keep focus in the field with Enter an address or property ID.
accept: Blank, spaces and pasted whitespace behave consistently and do not issue a search.

title: Search my property scrolls but leaves keyboard focus behind
impact: Keyboard users arrive visually at search but are still focused on the lower-page CTA.
steps: Activate Search my property and inspect focus.
actual: Page scrolls to the form; the CTA remains document.activeElement.
fix: After anchor navigation, focus the search input without a second scroll jump.
accept: Next typed characters enter the search field; visible focus is clear; reduced-motion preference is respected.

title: No-results wording does not support property-ID search
impact: An ID search failure gives irrelevant street-address advice.
actual: No matching addresses found; recovery only mentions street name, unit and spelling.
fix: Use No matching properties found. For numeric queries add Check the property ID or try a street address.
accept: Address and numeric no-result cases provide relevant recovery; real API errors remain distinct.

title: Browser Back loses a query entered on the home page
impact: A homeowner who selects the wrong suggestion must retype to try again.
steps: On home type 1102 Paw, select the suggestion with ArrowDown and Enter, then use browser Back.
actual: Home returns with a blank input. The property-page Back to search results link does retain context.
fix: Preserve the home form query in history state or an appropriate session-scoped form state and restore it on Back.
accept: Both browser Back and the in-app return link retain the useful query; no stale popup is restored.
